_about: Station monthly normals for the pre-built towns, read 14 November 2026 (after the Day 5 audit of 14 November 2026: the ERA5 grid's monthly means put the homestead freezing dates 1 to 5 weeks late, the Köppen class wrong at Kelowna, Thompson, Kingston, Spokane and Grand Forks, heating degree days 17 to 33 % low in Texas, and roof water in months frozen at the station). One station per town: the one src/lib/frost.ts townStation picks (the nearest first-order station inside 15 km, else the nearest station of any network there, else the nearest in the list) among the stations with published normals. noaa-normals: NOAA NCEI U.S. Climate Normals 1991-2020 (normals-monthly-1991-2020 MLY-TMAX/TMIN/PRCP-NORMAL, read in °F and inches and converted; normals-annualseasonal-1991-2020 ANN-TMIN-PRBLST-T32FP50 and ANN-TMIN-PRBFST-T32FP50, the dates by which half of years have had their last spring and first autumn night at or below 32 °F, and ANN-TMIN-AVGNDS-LSTH032, nights a year at or below 32 °F). ghcn-gsom: Canadian towns, where ECCC's normals could not be read (the normals portal does not render, api.weather.gc.ca is closed to robots and the bulk CSV returned an error): the means of NOAA's GHCN Global Summary of the Month values over 1991-2020, every calendar month with at least 15 years (ECCC's own minimum for its 1991-2020 normals); period is the span of the temperature years and years the fewest years behind any month. Applied to place-normals.json, place-rain.json and place-frost.json by scripts/build-station-normals.ts.
